target: Four-dimensional word-quadratic weighted-homogeneous AS-regular Z-algebras with primitive jumps (1,1,2,3), up to index-preserving isomorphism.

scope.broad_target: Q: primitive jumps, word-quadratic, two-sided AS4 and polynomial growth; word-Koszul, AS translation+7 and7-periodicity are now proved, not assumed
scope.graded_ore_locus: Over C: connected locally finite left/right noetherian AS4 graded algebras with minimal generator degrees (1,1,2,3) and H(t)=1/((1-t)^2(1-t^2)(1-t^3)), classified up to graded isomorphism; relations need not be word-quadratic
scope.quadratic_graded_ore_locus: The word-quadratic part of the preceding graded locus admits a complete Ore chart allowing non-diagonal automorphisms. Its associated Z-algebras lie in H and are 1-periodic; bare indexed isomorphism is a coarser relation.

Within the stated noetherian graded Hilbert locus over C: the full word-quadratic Ore chart, allowing non-diagonal automorphisms. Graded-isomorphism existence is characterized in prop:quadratic-isomorphisms; the displayed zero-correction conditions use generators adapted to a word-quadratic presentation.

resume_point.next_action: Build the 7-window path/dual engine for word lengths 0..5; run against the diagonal skew Ore chart and nonzero rho=1 examples. Use the non-diagonal quadratic graded Ore chart as a larger reference family. Derive invariant branches outside the hypotheses of the noetherian graded Hilbert locus, especially nonconstant rho_i patterns, and determine additional identifications under bare indexed isomorphism. Keep Frobenius and Koszul tests separate.
resume_point.obstacle: The complete iterated Ore result assumes a graded algebra over C, left/right noetherianity and the prescribed Hilbert series. The general seven-window AS locus, nonconstant rho_i patterns and the full bare indexed quotient remain unresolved. Four diagonal presentation components are not moduli components.
resume_point.do_not_repeat: The noetherian graded Hilbert locus over C has a complete iterated Ore description, finite coefficient equations and all triangular graded isomorphisms; its word-quadratic part allows non-diagonal automorphisms. The exact diagonal skew Ore equations, four presentation components, regularity and rho separation are also proved. General Koszul/AS-index7 and H=S results remain available; Q=H is still open.
